gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma or radiographic findings consistent with a high grade glioma in patients undergoing surgery for initial diagnosis

candidate_evidence.quote: Azeliragon is an oral RAGE inhibitor. Blocking the RAGE pathway at the time of surgery (peri-operatively) may decrease cerebral edema.
Determine the lowest dose of dexamethasone that needs to be co-administered with azeliragon for treatment of post-resection cerebral edema in patients with glioblastoma.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Determine brain concentrations of azeliragon in resected tumor tissue from Arm 1 participants.
Will assess azeliragon concentrations in tumor samples compared to azeliragon concentrations in blood.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Describe post-operative changes in levels of RAGE ligands in brain interstitium, peripheral blood, and resection cavity fluid (when possible to obtain) in study participants.

role_evidence.quote: Azeliragon is an oral RAGE inhibitor. Blocking the RAGE pathway at the time of surgery (peri-operatively) may decrease cerebral edema.
Determine the lowest dose of dexamethasone that needs to be co-administered with azeliragon for treatment of post-resection cerebral edema in patients with glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Both drugs are for post-resection cerebral oedema (symptom control); no antitumour hypothesis or outcome is stated, so both supportive and no candidate. Azeliragon is the investigational agent for oedema. Population coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named because conditions list malignant glioma and eligibility allows radiographic high-grade glioma. Dexamethasone is the comparator-arm drug but also given in the experimental arm; coded supportive.
